10917
10918// Depending on the value of a char (or wchar_t), we print it in one
10919// of three formats:
10920// - as is if it's a printable ASCII (e.g. 'a', '2', ' '),
10921// - as a hexadecimal escape sequence (e.g. '\x7F'), or
10922// - as a special escape sequence (e.g. '\r', '\n').
10923enum CharFormat {
10924 kAsIs,
10925 kHexEscape,
10926 kSpecialEscape
10927};
10928
10929// Returns true if c is a printable ASCII character. We test the
10930// value of c directly instead of calling isprint(), which is buggy on
10931// Windows Mobile.
10932inline bool IsPrintableAscii(wchar_t c) {
10933 return 0x20 <= c && c <= 0x7E;
10934}
10935
10936// Prints a wide or narrow char c as a character literal without the
10937// quotes, escaping it when necessary; returns how c was formatted.
10938// The template argument UnsignedChar is the unsigned version of Char,
10939// which is the type of c.
10940template <typename UnsignedChar, typename Char>
10941static CharFormat PrintAsCharLiteralTo(Char c, ostream* os) {
10942 switch (static_cast<wchar_t>(c)) {
10943 case L'\0':
10944 *os << "\\0";
10945 break;
10946 case L'\'':
10947 *os << "\\'";
10948 break;
10949 case L'\\':
10950 *os << "\\\\";
10951 break;
10952 case L'\a':
10953 *os << "\\a";
10954 break;
10955 case L'\b':
10956 *os << "\\b";
10957 break;
10958 case L'\f':
10959 *os << "\\f";
10960 break;
10961 case L'\n':
10962 *os << "\\n";
10963 break;
10964 case L'\r':
10965 *os << "\\r";
10966 break;
10967 case L'\t':
10968 *os << "\\t";
10969 break;
10970 case L'\v':
10971 *os << "\\v";
10972 break;
10973 default:
10974 if (IsPrintableAscii(c)) {
10975 *os << static_cast<char>(c);
10976 return kAsIs;
10977 } else {
10978 ostream::fmtflags flags = os->flags();
10979 *os << "\\x" << std::hex << std::uppercase
10980 << static_cast<int>(static_cast<UnsignedChar>(c));
10981 os->flags(flags);
10982 return kHexEscape;
10983 }
10984 }
10985 return kSpecialEscape;
10986}
10987
10988// Prints a wchar_t c as if it's part of a string literal, escaping it when
10989// necessary; returns how c was formatted.
10990static CharFormat PrintAsStringLiteralTo(wchar_t c, ostream* os) {
10991 switch (c) {
10992 case L'\'':
10993 *os << "'";
10994 return kAsIs;
10995 case L'"':
10996 *os << "\\\"";
10997 return kSpecialEscape;
10998 default:
10999 return PrintAsCharLiteralTo<wchar_t>(c, os);
11000 }
11001}
11002
11003// Prints a char c as if it's part of a string literal, escaping it when
11004// necessary; returns how c was formatted.
11005static CharFormat PrintAsStringLiteralTo(char c, ostream* os) {
11006 return PrintAsStringLiteralTo(
11007 static_cast<wchar_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)), os);
11008}
11009
11010// Prints a wide or narrow character c and its code. '\0' is printed
11011// as "'\\0'", other unprintable characters are also properly escaped
11012// using the standard C++ escape sequence. The template argument
11013// UnsignedChar is the unsigned version of Char, which is the type of c.
11014template <typename UnsignedChar, typename Char>
11015void PrintCharAndCodeTo(Char c, ostream* os) {
11016 // First, print c as a literal in the most readable form we can find.
11017 *os << ((sizeof(c) > 1) ? "L'" : "'");
11018 const CharFormat format = PrintAsCharLiteralTo<UnsignedChar>(c, os);
11019 *os << "'";
11020
11021 // To aid user debugging, we also print c's code in decimal, unless
11022 // it's 0 (in which case c was printed as '\\0', making the code
11023 // obvious).
11024 if (c == 0)
11025 return;
11026 *os << " (" << static_cast<int>(c);
11027
11028 // For more convenience, we print c's code again in hexadecimal,
11029 // unless c was already printed in the form '\x##' or the code is in
11030 // [1, 9].
11031 if (format == kHexEscape || (1 <= c && c <= 9)) {
11032 // Do nothing.
11033 } else {
11034 *os << ", 0x" << String::FormatHexInt(static_cast<UnsignedChar>(c));
11035 }
11036 *os << ")";
11037}
11038
11039void PrintTo(unsigned char c, ::std::ostream* os) {
11040 PrintCharAndCodeTo<unsigned char>(c, os);
11041}
11042void PrintTo(signed char c, ::std::ostream* os) {
11043 PrintCharAndCodeTo<unsigned char>(c, os);
11044}
11045
11046// Prints a wchar_t as a symbol if it is printable or as its internal
11047// code otherwise and also as its code. L'\0' is printed as "L'\\0'".
11048void PrintTo(wchar_t wc, ostream* os) {
11049 PrintCharAndCodeTo<wchar_t>(wc, os);
11050}
11051
11052// Prints the given array of characters to the ostream. CharType must be either
11053// char or wchar_t.
11054// The array starts at begin, the length is len, it may include '\0' characters
11055// and may not be NUL-terminated.
11056template <typename CharType>
11057GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_MEMORY_
11058GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_ADDRESS_
11059GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_THREAD_
11060static CharFormat PrintCharsAsStringTo(
11061 const CharType* begin, size_t len, ostream* os) {
11062 const char* const kQuoteBegin = sizeof(CharType) == 1 ? "\"" : "L\"";
11063 *os << kQuoteBegin;
11064 bool is_previous_hex = false;
11065 CharFormat print_format = kAsIs;
11066 for (size_t index = 0; index < len; ++index) {
11067 const CharType cur = begin[index];
11068 if (is_previous_hex && IsXDigit(cur)) {
11069 // Previous character is of '\x..' form and this character can be
11070 // interpreted as another hexadecimal digit in its number. Break string to
11071 // disambiguate.
11072 *os << "\" " << kQuoteBegin;
11073 }
11074 is_previous_hex = PrintAsStringLiteralTo(cur, os) == kHexEscape;
11075 // Remember if any characters required hex escaping.
11076 if (is_previous_hex) {
11077 print_format = kHexEscape;
11078 }
11079 }
11080 *os << "\"";
11081 return print_format;
11082}
11083
11084// Prints a (const) char/wchar_t array of 'len' elements, starting at address
11085// 'begin'. CharType must be either char or wchar_t.
11086template <typename CharType>
11087GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_MEMORY_
11088GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_ADDRESS_
11089GTEST_ATTRIBUTE_NO_SANITIZE_THREAD_
11090static void UniversalPrintCharArray(
11091 const CharType* begin, size_t len, ostream* os) {
11092 // The code
11093 // const char kFoo[] = "foo";
11094 // generates an array of 4, not 3, elements, with the last one being '\0'.
11095 //
11096 // Therefore when printing a char array, we don't print the last element if
11097 // it's '\0', such that the output matches the string literal as it's
11098 // written in the source code.
11099 if (len > 0 && begin[len - 1] == '\0') {
11100 PrintCharsAsStringTo(begin, len - 1, os);
11101 return;
11102 }
11103
11104 // If, however, the last element in the array is not '\0', e.g.
11105 // const char kFoo[] = { 'f', 'o', 'o' };
11106 // we must print the entire array. We also print a message to indicate
11107 // that the array is not NUL-terminated.
11108 PrintCharsAsStringTo(begin, len, os);
11109 *os << " (no terminating NUL)";
11110}
11111
11112// Prints a (const) char array of 'len' elements, starting at address 'begin'.
11113void UniversalPrintArray(const char* begin, size_t len, ostream* os) {
11114 UniversalPrintCharArray(begin, len, os);
11115}
11116
11117// Prints a (const) wchar_t array of 'len' elements, starting at address
11118// 'begin'.
11119void UniversalPrintArray(const wchar_t* begin, size_t len, ostream* os) {
11120 UniversalPrintCharArray(begin, len, os);
11121}
11122
11123// Prints the given C string to the ostream.
11124void PrintTo(const char* s, ostream* os) {
11125 if (s == NULL) {
11126 *os << "NULL";
11127 } else {
11128 *os << ImplicitCast_<const void*>(s) << " pointing to ";
11129 PrintCharsAsStringTo(s, strlen(s), os);
11130 }
11131}
11132
11133// MSVC compiler can be configured to define whar_t as a typedef
11134// of unsigned short. Defining an overload for const wchar_t* in that case
11135// would cause pointers to unsigned shorts be printed as wide strings,
11136// possibly accessing more memory than intended and causing invalid
11137// memory accesses. MSVC defines _NATIVE_WCHAR_T_DEFINED symbol when
11138// wchar_t is implemented as a native type.
11139#if !defined(_MSC_VER) || defined(_NATIVE_WCHAR_T_DEFINED)
11140// Prints the given wide C string to the ostream.
11141void PrintTo(const wchar_t* s, ostream* os) {
11142 if (s == NULL) {
11143 *os << "NULL";
11144 } else {
11145 *os << ImplicitCast_<const void*>(s) << " pointing to ";
11146 PrintCharsAsStringTo(s, std::wcslen(s), os);
11147 }
11148}
11149#endif // wchar_t is native

11153bool ContainsUnprintableControlCodes(const char* str, size_t length) {
11154 const unsigned char *s = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(str);
11155
11156 for (size_t i = 0; i < length; i++) {
11157 unsigned char ch = *s++;
11158 if (std::iscntrl(ch)) {
11159 switch (ch) {
11160 case '\t':
11161 case '\n':
11162 case '\r':
11163 break;
11164 default:
11165 return true;
11166 }
11167 }
11168 }
11169 return false;
11170}
11171
11172bool IsUTF8TrailByte(unsigned char t) { return 0x80 <= t && t<= 0xbf; }
11173
11174bool IsValidUTF8(const char* str, size_t length) {
11175 const unsigned char *s = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char *>(str);
11176
11177 for (size_t i = 0; i < length;) {
11178 unsigned char lead = s[i++];
11179
11180 if (lead <= 0x7f) {
11181 continue; // single-byte character (ASCII) 0..7F
11182 }
11183 if (lead < 0xc2) {
11184 return false; // trail byte or non-shortest form
11185 } else if (lead <= 0xdf && (i + 1) <= length && IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i])) {
11186 ++i; // 2-byte character
11187 } else if (0xe0 <= lead && lead <= 0xef && (i + 2) <= length &&
11188 IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i]) &&
11189 IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i + 1]) &&
11190 // check for non-shortest form and surrogate
11191 (lead != 0xe0 || s[i] >= 0xa0) &&
11192 (lead != 0xed || s[i] < 0xa0)) {
11193 i += 2; // 3-byte character
11194 } else if (0xf0 <= lead && lead <= 0xf4 && (i + 3) <= length &&
11195 IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i]) &&
11196 IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i + 1]) &&
11197 IsUTF8TrailByte(s[i + 2]) &&
11198 // check for non-shortest form
11199 (lead != 0xf0 || s[i] >= 0x90) &&
11200 (lead != 0xf4 || s[i] < 0x90)) {
11201 i += 3; // 4-byte character
11202 } else {
11203 return false;
11204 }
11205 }
11206 return true;
11207}
11208
11209void ConditionalPrintAsText(const char* str, size_t length, ostream* os) {
11210 if (!ContainsUnprintableControlCodes(str, length) &&
11211 IsValidUTF8(str, length)) {
11212 *os << "\n As Text: \"" << str << "\"";
11213 }
11214}
11215
11216} // anonymous namespace

11223 ConditionalPrintAsText(s.data(), s.size(), os);

11389// Skips to the first non-space char in str. Returns an empty string if str
11390// contains only whitespace characters.
11391static const char* SkipSpaces(const char* str) {
11392 while (IsSpace(*str))
11393 str++;
11394 return str;
11395}
11396
11397static std::vector<std::string> SplitIntoTestNames(const char* src) {
11398 std::vector<std::string> name_vec;
11399 src = SkipSpaces(src);
11400 for (; src != NULL; src = SkipComma(src)) {
11401 name_vec.push_back(StripTrailingSpaces(GetPrefixUntilComma(src)));
11402 }
11403 return name_vec;
11404}
11405
11406// Verifies that registered_tests match the test names in
11407// registered_tests_; returns registered_tests if successful, or
11408// aborts the program otherwise.
11409const char* TypedTestCasePState::VerifyRegisteredTestNames(
11410 const char* file, int line, const char* registered_tests) {
11411 typedef RegisteredTestsMap::const_iterator RegisteredTestIter;
11412 registered_ = true;
11413
11414 std::vector<std::string> name_vec = SplitIntoTestNames(registered_tests);
11415
11416 Message errors;
11417
11418 std::set<std::string> tests;
11419 for (std::vector<std::string>::const_iterator name_it = name_vec.begin();
11420 name_it != name_vec.end(); ++name_it) {
11421 const std::string& name = *name_it;
11422 if (tests.count(name) != 0) {
11423 errors << "Test " << name << " is listed more than once.\n";
11424 continue;
11425 }
11426
11427 bool found = false;
11428 for (RegisteredTestIter it = registered_tests_.begin();
11429 it != registered_tests_.end();
11430 ++it) {
11431 if (name == it->first) {
11432 found = true;
11433 break;
11434 }
11435 }
11436
11437 if (found) {
11438 tests.insert(name);
11439 } else {
11440 errors << "No test named " << name
11441 << " can be found in this test case.\n";
11442 }
11443 }
11444
11445 for (RegisteredTestIter it = registered_tests_.begin();
11446 it != registered_tests_.end();
11447 ++it) {
11448 if (tests.count(it->first) == 0) {
11449 errors << "You forgot to list test " << it->first << ".\n";
11450 }
11451 }
11452
11453 const std::string& errors_str = errors.GetString();
11454 if (errors_str != "") {
11455 fprintf(stderr, "%s %s", FormatFileLocation(file, line).c_str(),
11456 errors_str.c_str());
11457 fflush(stderr);
11458 posix::Abort();
11459 }
11460
11461 return registered_tests;
11462}
